about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Meet Captain Nikos and learn about our passion for fishing
about.metaDescription: Learn the story behind our family-run fishing charters and the team that makes every trip memorable.
about.captainBio: With over 20 years of experience fishing in Amvrakikos Bay, Captain Nikos knows all the best spots and techniques to ensure you have an unforgettable experience.
about.storyParagraph1: What began as a small family boat in the early 2000s has become one of the most trusted fishing experiences in the region.
about.storyParagraph2: We celebrate the traditions of the Amvrakikos Gulf while introducing guests to modern, comfortable fishing adventures.
about.storyParagraph3: From sunrise departures to sunset returns, we craft experiences that blend hospitality, expertise, and local flavor.

captainHighlights.experienceDesc: Two decades of guiding guests to the bay's best fishing grounds.
captainHighlights.familyDesc: A warm, welcoming crew that treats every guest like family.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about our fishing trips
faq.metaDescription: Get quick answers about booking, trips, and payment for Amvrakikos Fishing Trips.
faq.contactPrompt: Still have questions? Contact us and we'll be happy to help.

booking.q1: How far in advance should I book?
booking.a1: We recommend booking at least two weeks ahead, especially during summer.
booking.a2: Yes. Let us know 48 hours in advance and we'll find a new date.

trips.a1: Not at all. Our crew will guide you through every step.
trips.q2: What should I bring with me?
trips.a2: Bring sunscreen, a hat, and a light jacket. We provide all fishing gear.

payments.q1: What payment methods do you accept?
payments.a1: We accept major credit cards and bank transfers.
payments.a2: A small deposit confirms your reservation, with the balance due on the day.

general.q1: Is the trip suitable for families?
general.a1: Absolutely! We welcome guests of all ages and tailor the trip to your group.
general.q2: Will we see dolphins or wildlife?
general.a2: The bay is rich with wildlife, and sightings are common during trips.
